maintenance_tasks.description: [DEMO] Rectification of slew and versine defects detected during OMS run. Packing and lining required at 3 locations.
[DEMO] 90R rail replacement due to hogged joint. Three rails (total 36m) to be replaced on UP main line.
[DEMO] Worn check rails and crossing panels at manned LC-47 require renewal. Traffic restriction (30 kmph) currently in force.
[DEMO] Annual tamping and screening required. BCM to be deployed for 4 km section.
[DEMO] Contact wire wear beyond permissible limit (7mm residual). Replacement of 1500m section on UP line required.
[DEMO] Annual preventive maintenance of 25kV traction transformer. Insulation testing, oil sampling, and bushing inspection.
[DEMO] OHE wire sagging detected in 25km section. Wire height correction and re-tensioning required.
[DEMO] LED cluster replacement on home signal ALJN-44. Signal showing degraded luminosity during last inspection.
[DEMO] Periodic overhaul of clamp-lock point machine. Current stroke time 4.2s — threshold is 4.0s.
[DEMO] Calibration and reset of axle counter section CNB-12 following intermittent failure reports from loco pilots.
[DEMO] Intermediate Overhaul (IOH) of WAP-7 locomotive #30411. Current mileage: 2,25,000 km. IOH due at 2,40,000 km.

block_requests.notes: Track geometry correction at TDL-162. CSM 09-32 required.
Urgent rail replacement at CNB-105. Night block essential.
OHE contact wire replacement ALJN-22. Power block + LWR isolation required.
Axle counter calibration AC-CNB-12. Safety critical — urgent completion.
Ballast tamping GZB-018 DN Main. BCM deployment planned.
OHE tensioning CNB–FTP section. 25km stretch, multi-gang deployment.
Point machine overhaul PM-17. Special tools required from DEN office.
Routine inspection of LC-47 panels and check rails.
TSS-4 transformer annual PM. Full isolation of CNB-FTP section required.
BCR-05 crane annual load test at Agra. Non-traffic block during day hours.
